info.title: API-DocTest-List Retail Orders Tracks-v5-spec
info.description: The Retail Order Tracking API enables users to monitor the status of retail orders in real-time. By accessing this API, consumers can retrieve detailed tracking information for their orders, including shipment status and estimated delivery dates. This functionality is crucial for retailers and logistics providers who aim to enhance customer satisfaction by providing timely updates. Typical users include online retailers, supply chain managers, and customer service teams who need to ensure efficient order fulfillment and customer communication.

get.summary: Retrieve the tracking details of an order.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to get the current tracking status and details of a specific order using its unique identifier. You can use this information to monitor the progress of the order's shipment from the warehouse to the delivery address.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary information for tracking an order. It must include the relevant details to identify the order being tracked.

200.description: The tracking information for the order has been retrieved successfully.

ListRetailOrdersTracksRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to tracking orders.

ListRetailOrdersTracksResponse_200.title: Order Tracking Response

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the tracking request.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the order being tracked.

state.description: Current state of the order being tracked.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the tracking request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the request or its result.

ListRetailOrdersTracksResponse_200.description: Response schema for the GET order tracking operation, containing the status and details of the order tracking process.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the tracking record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the tracking record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the tracking record was created automatically or manually.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing auditing details for the order tracking operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
